name: soc-ir-profile
description: SOC incident response profile: connects every analyst's Claude session to the shared incident-mcp case server, with skills for opening, connecting, adding evidence, digests, incident meetings and the engineering queue.

analyst_name.title: Your name in the case log
analyst_name.description: Shown as the author of everything you add, e.g. analyst-b or your first name.

analyst_role.title: Your role
analyst_role.description: analyst, lead, manager or engineer. Changes what Claude leads with; grants no permissions in the POC.

analyst_team.title: Your team id (engineers only)
analyst_team.description: A team id from config/org/teams.yml, e.g. detection-eng. Leave empty if you are not on a supporting team.
